title: Battles of Batočina and Jagodina
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battles of Batočina and Jagodina", at revision 1370603511, opens: "The Battles of Batočina and Jagodina were several battles fought in late March–April in Batočina and Jagodina between the Serbian rebels under Karađorđe and the Dahije leader Kučuk-Alija. The Serbian rebels aimed to take Jagodina while Kučuk-Alija mustered and hired troops in the region to deal with the rebellion. The Batočina inn was besieged to stop reinforcements and led to a pursuit and destruction of a Janissary contingent at a river bank. Next, a siege of Jagodina, held by Kučuk-Alija, failed miserably due to bad weather conditions. The next attack was successful after an assault and day of shootouts in the town." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q24913478, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1804 battle of the First Serbian Uprising". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
